Cabin

Mutfak elektriği

The electrical power supply dedicated to the aircraft galley, required for safe operation of galley equipment such as ovens, boilers, and coffee makers. Galley power is routinely switched off during takeoff and landing as a safety precaution.

Kisa cevap: The electrical power supply dedicated to the aircraft galley, required for safe operation of galley equipment such as ovens, boilers, and coffee makers. Galley power is routinely switched off during takeoff and landing as a safety precaution.

Neden onemli

Mutfak elektriği, Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, ve Cabin Crew icin Cabin baglamlarinda daha net iletisim kurmaya yardimci oldugu icin onemlidir. Ayrica ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, ve EASA FCL.055 gibi egitim ve sinav dilleriyle bag kurar.

Mutfak elektriği nedir?

Bu sozlukte Mutfak elektriği su sekilde aciklanir: The electrical power supply dedicated to the aircraft galley, required for safe operation of galley equipment such as ovens, boilers, and coffee makers. Galley power is routinely switched off during takeoff and landing as a safety precaution.

Mutfak elektriği havacilikta nasil kullanilir?

Havacilik iletisiminde bu terim su baglamlarda kullanilir: "Kabin ekibi, yemek servisine başlamadan önce mutfak elektriğinin açık olduğunu teyit edin."

Mutfak elektriği havacilikta neden onemlidir?

Mutfak elektriği, Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, ve Cabin Crew icin Cabin baglamlarinda daha net iletisim kurmaya yardimci oldugu icin onemlidir. Ayrica ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, ve EASA FCL.055 gibi egitim ve sinav dilleriyle bag kurar.

Mutfak elektriği kimler tarafindan kullanilir?

Mutfak elektriği agirlikli olarak Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, ve Cabin Crew tarafindan kullanilir.

Mutfak elektriği hangi kategoriye aittir?

Bu sozlukte Mutfak elektriği, Cabin kategorisi altinda yer alir. Bu kategori yakin prosedurleri, komutlari ve operasyonel kavramlari bir araya getirir.

Bu tanim hangi kaynaga dayanir?

Bu tanim ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG kaynaklarina dayanir ve Protermify Aviation tarafindan statik havacilik referansi olarak yayinlanir.

Tanim

The electrical power supply dedicated to the aircraft galley, required for safe operation of galley equipment such as ovens, boilers, and coffee makers. Galley power is routinely switched off during takeoff and landing as a safety precaution.

Cabin crew, please confirm galley power is on before starting meal service.
